Dragon Name Generator

Forge fearsome dragon names from draconic syllables, each crowned with a title epithet like “the Ashwing”.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose whether to include a title epithet.
  2. Pick how many names to generate.
  3. Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Will I get unique combinations?

Yes — with 24 fire-themed roots, 16 cores, and 20 endings plus 24 titles, the combinations run into the hundreds of thousands.

What is a title epithet?

The title epithet is a dramatic honorific (like “the Embermaw”) that follows the dragon's name — toggle it off for bare names.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
